name: asset-l10-dispersal-hall
note: L10 turbine hall block with the exposed turbine train and roller door (+X), courier for scale. Look for: walls and roof closed, turbine casing on its cradles, stacks upright, no floating parts. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read.
